notes.title: Weeklong Deals! Lobster Empire 40% off!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30097444/b5d690288ff9554ebad0c3700d1ccb9e8f5fa2f2.png[/img]

Hello guys :D

We have good news for all of you guys who haven't play Lobster Empire yet. From [b] April 5, 2021 until April 12, 2021 [/b] we will give you [b]Weeklong Deals discount, 40% 0ff[/b]! A big offer for brave lobstermen out there! 

In Lobster Empire, you're not only catching or fishing lobster so you can sell it, but also you'll hatching or breeding lobster then release it so you can balance the number of lobster in the ocean. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/665960/Lobster_Empire/

If you want to know how to become a great lobstermen and a success lobster businessman, then don't waste your time, go grab Lobster Empire fast and become number one lobstermen :D

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h1]Try Our Other Games Too!![/h1]

Our other games are also joining the Weeklong Deals too! You should check it out!

[h3][b]Legion Tale[/b][/h3]
Take part in the story set in Agia, a continent inflicted with conflicts between two races. Join Alan, a young man from Scarleta who leads a small legion of warriors, to take over the reign of Dark Lord. Find the true reason behind the conquest for Agia in this tactical turn-based game.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/604040/Legion_Tale/

[h3][b]Aquaculture Land: Fish Farming Simulation[/b][/h3]
Aquaculture Land is a fish farming management game. You will act as a freshwater fish farm manager to nurture different varieties of fish, produce high-quality commodities, and fulfill your customers' needs to grow your business.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/858630/Aquaculture_Land_Fish_Farming_Simulation/

[h3][b]Multishop Tycoon Deluxe[/b][/h3]
Multishop Tycoon Game lets you start and grow your company and become a food business tycoon. This is a simplified business model of food selling shop network. Earn the optimum profit as best as you can. To make it true, try your best to make your stuff sold out every day, take advantage of the opportunity, sharpen your sales and business skill, train all your sellers, also use all promotion media.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/568780/Multishop_Tycoon_Deluxe/

We’ll be waiting for you guys!
Cheers!

notes.title: ⚠ Major Updates, Added Content, and New Trailer Released! version 1.0.2a
notes.content:
Dear players,
Thanks to all players and all those who have helped us to make the final version perfect. The update process of this game is quite time consuming but we are very grateful for your patience to wait.

In this new patch we have made some changes and improvements:
1. All bugs (both major and minor) that occurred in the first version have been fixed.
2. New features: event in the voyage, which will determine the fate of boats and voyages. All the attributes of lobstermen will also play a major role in this feature. It may feel heavy in the beginning, but with a good lobstermen team management, everything will be okay.
3. New features: Game system on hatchery updated. Now the juvenile lobster release will have a direct impact on the red zone reforestation.
4. New features: some new upgrade items have been added and have big impact especially in Era 2 and Era 3.
5. Sequence of the quest has been updated. There are several new quests added. Some quests that are seems monotonous or too difficult have been omitted.
6. All difficulties have been rebalanced, some of which were raised while some others downgraded.

By the way, we also upload a new trailers and some new screenshots. Feel free to take a look at the store page: http://store.steampowered.com/app/665960/Lobster_Empire/

Meet our Calico!!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/IlbRByy.jpg[/img]

Thanks, guys. Hopefully in 2018 we all can get better achievements of all things.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/lEmA8su.gif[/img]
